AntiPattern.Bad: `await page.locator('.btn-primary.submit-action').click();` — CSS class chain as the primary locator.
AntiPattern.WhyBad: CSS selectors couple the test to implementation (`AX_E2E_ROLE_LOCATORS_ONLY`). Any class rename — even one driven by a refactor that does not change behaviour — turns the test red. The user-facing contract has no concept of `.btn-primary`.
AntiPattern.Good: `await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Place Order' }).click();` — role + accessible name, mirroring how the user identifies the element.
